messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC-2150 High 5xx + session loss across multi-region after automated failover. Trigger: traffic-manager auto-shift to eu-west-1 after us-east-1 partial AZ instability. First seen: 2065432100.

emma (SRE): ack. i'm on. grabbing cluster and routing graphs. tagging networking & infra.

kate (oncall): oncall-kate here. quick question: did traffic-manager shift all traffic off us-east-1 or partial?

deploy-bot: traffic-manager: auto-shift executed at 2065432112 -> us-east-1=20% us-west-2=0% eu-west-1=80% (policy: regional-failover).

jordan (infra): early telemetry: eu-west-1 backend nodes showing high SYN backlog and connection resets. NAT pool exhaustion on the newly-loaded edge NATs suspected.

vikram (networking): looking at anycast edges: many POPs already healthy toward eu-west-1, but a subset of large CDN resolvers still point at us-east-1 origins. Combined with backend NAT exhaustion, some sessions are getting half-routed -> long tails + 502s.

cs-lead (ops): support-triage: 18 customer tickets opened in last 6m; 5 flagged P1 by customers (stream disconnects + failed webhook deliveries). Preparing CS holding message.

emma (SRE): mitigation priority: avoid cascading failure in eu-west-1 while stabilizing us-east-1. Proposed steps: 1) pause autoswitch 2) reduce eu-west-1 weight to preserve capacity 3) enable NAT autoscale or add extra NAT gateways 4) TTL override on edge hosts to steer resolvers. Approve?

kate (oncall): approve. pausing autoswitch now.

deploy-bot: traffic-manager: autoswitch paused by kate (oncall) at 2065432135.

jordan (infra): spinning additional NAT capacity in eu-west-1 now: `cloudctl nat create --region eu-west-1 --count 3 --type t3.medium` -> started at 2065432140.

vikram (networking): applying manual weights: `traffic-manager set-weight --region eu-west-1 60 --region us-east-1 40` at 2065432148 to reduce instant load on eu-west-1.

emma (SRE): good. also adding a short TTL override: edge-ctrl set-ttl --host api.redwood.com --ttl 30 at 2065432152. Note: some third-party resolvers ignore our TTL, but should help most.

status-bot: Status page draft: "Partial service disruption due to traffic failover stress; mitigation in progress. Some customers may experience intermittent errors." Link placeholder.

jordan (infra): NAT capacity is provisioning. earliest alloc shows connection table growth stabilizing after new NATs start accepting traffic at 2065432175.

vikram (networking): even as NATs come up, we're seeing app-level p99 increases from 250ms -> 1.2s in eu-west-1 due to cache warmups and increased disk I/O. Need to watch for backend overload.

emma (SRE): do we have headroom to redirect more traffic back to us-east-1 while we heal eu-west-1?

vikram (networking): some edge POPs still serve us-east-1 origin. We can increase us-east-1 weight to 50% but risk re-triggering autoswitch if edge metrics misinterpret short-term errors. Manual weights only.

kate (oncall): go ahead increase us-east-1 to 50%. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: traffic-manager: manual weights applied -> eu-west-1=50 us-east-1=50 at 2065432188.

cs-lead (ops): CS update posted: "Investigating cross-region traffic issues causing intermittent errors. We're taking steps to stabilize routing and will update shortly." Customers asked for ETA; giving conservative 60m.

emma (SRE): watchlist: 1) 5xx rate, 2) session disconnect rate, 3) NAT connection table headroom in eu-west-1, 4) p99 latency. Escalate if 5xx >1% sustained for 10m.

jordan (infra): NAT autoscale policy: temporary threshold lowered to 60% table usage; autoscale firing now. New gateways created at 2065432205. Connection resets drop notably after 2065432215.

vikram (networking): note: several dedicated-tenant deployments had static egress IPs in us-east-1 and their clients are still hitting us-east origins -> they see better success than general population. However, some third-party webhooks that targeted eu-west-1 got delayed.

emma (SRE): mitigation verification: 5xx reduced from 4.7% -> 0.9% over 6m. websocket disconnects decreased but some long-lived streaming sessions still reconnecting.

kate (oncall): handoff: i'll remain on-call for next 90m. emma, if things look stable please escalate to morning shift with postmortem items.

jordan (infra): follow-up: we should add NAT pool headroom to failover playbook — our current playbook assumes target region has spare NAT capacity. Creating ticket PMT-361.

vikram (networking): also recommend traffic-manager gating: require both LB health and edge-pop consistency before a regional auto-shift. Filed follow-up.

deploy-bot: tenant-proxy deploy started for tenant big-retail at 2065432230. This is to preserve long-lived sessions for that customer while routes stabilize.

cs-lead (ops): two priority enterprise customers requested on-call bridge. Joining now.

emma (SRE): creating short incident runbook in thread for handoff: actions taken, current weights, TTL override, NAT autoscale, tenant proxies, escalation criteria.

postmortem-bot: Created PMT-361: "INC-2150 - Failover-induced NAT exhaustion and routing inconsistency" with owners jordan (infra), vikram (networking), emma (SRE) at 2065432245.

status-bot: Status update posted: "Mitigation: Additional NAT capacity provisioned in eu-west-1, traffic rebalanced to reduce load, temporary proxies for key customers. Monitoring."

emma (SRE): final checks: 5xx at 0.6% last sample, p99 latency trending down. Keep thread open 45m. Add item: test full failover in chaos lab including NAT scaling on target region.

kate (oncall): taking over monitoring. escalation criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 10m OR p99 >3s. Leaving summary in incident ticket. Good work team. :white_check_mark:.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2150 status changed to Monitoring by kate (oncall) at 2065432448.

emma (SRE): closing immediate mitigation actions. Postmortem owners assigned. Will draft narrative tonight.

kate (oncall): will hand off to morning shift with PMT-361 and the runbook notes. Thread stays open until stable 45m.

postmortem-bot: Reminder: include timeline and deploy artifacts for PMT-361.

emma (SRE): thanks everyone. adding final note: consider adding proactive NAT capacity checks for failover targets as part of readiness tests.

status-bot: Incident INC-2150 marked as Monitoring.
